gaps.sentence: Should the temperature ___ 40 degrees, the system shuts down.
gaps.explanation: Should the temperature exceed… = if it exceeds… — technical register.

gaps.sentence: ___ you require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact the desk.
gaps.explanation: 'Should you require …' = 'If you should require …' — formal inverted conditional.

gaps.sentence: Under no circumstances ___ the door be left unlocked.
gaps.explanation: 'Under no circumstances should/must the door be left unlocked' — modal + inversion.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I hung up than the phone rang again.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had I hung up than …' — the fixed inverted pair.

gaps.sentence: Never ___ I expect to see my own name on the shortlist.
gaps.explanation: 'Never did I expect …' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Come ___ it may, the trial must proceed.
gaps.explanation: 'Come what may' — fixed inverted idiom = whatever happens.

gaps.sentence: Not since the winter of 1963 ___ temperatures dropped so low.
gaps.explanation: 'Not since 1963 have temperatures dropped …' — the only time from then until now.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ it occur to her that the letter had been a forgery.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later' at the front inverts with do-support: did it occur to her.
